title: Random SIGABRT on macOS 26.01 Apple Silicon M1 Max on headless export
body:
### Tested versions

Note: This isn't reproducable every time.

- Reproducable in 4.5.stable.official.876b29033


### System information

macos 26.0.1 (25A362) - godot 4.5.stable.official.876b29033 - Apple Silicon M1 Max - MacBookPro18,4

### Issue description

Randomly, upon running `godot --headless --export-release "Web" export/web/index.html`, I get a crash.

The latest time was with this source code: docwhat/screams-into-the-void@41c89e9bcf91e97dcb338bdd3f069f95d9ff166e

To the best of my memory, it always occurs in `EditorExportPlatformAppleEmbedded`.

### Steps to reproduce

I use the `mise` command: `mise export-web`.

Here are the steps for your reference:

```sh
rm -rf export/web
mkdir -p export
mkdir export/web
godot --headless --export-release "Web" export/web/index.html
```

As I said above, this is a heisen bug. You may have to run it multiple times.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I apologize. I am unable to create an MRP.

However, it breaks on my project, docwhat/screams-into-the-void@41c89e9bcf91e97dcb338bdd3f069f95d9ff166e, one out of 4 times.
